lines: Account creation now skips username registration and stores the generated local key for signing.
Share links now open directly in Highlighter, with native logging and relay diagnostics wired across app surfaces.
Android now includes the full native shell: tabs, settings, dark mode, persisted sessions, relay status, edit profile, curation, and podcast playback.
Capture publishing, clip sharing, and book picker search now use the same Rust-owned app state across iOS and Android.
Network settings now show which rooms use a relay before removal and explain missing relay lists more clearly during import.
Article reading and highlight publishing now use the same Rust-owned state on iOS and Android.
Profile pages and follow buttons now use the same Rust-owned state on iOS and Android.
Recent searches now sync through the same Rust-owned search state on iOS and Android.
Bookmarks, collections, and web bookmarks now render from Rust-owned library snapshots on iOS and Android.
Room discovery and the highlights home feed now use the same Rust-owned snapshots on iOS and Android.
Account creation now validates usernames consistently across iOS and Android.
Discussion posts now keep valid URL attachments instead of dropping them.
Book lookups now use the same cached ISBN metadata across iOS and Android.
Onboarding interest setup now stays consistent across app launches and platform shells.
Tapping 'Open room' from a profile's Communities tab now navigates to the room properly instead of dismissing immediately.
Introduced What's New — you'll see updates here after each release.
